title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is Bridge Creek Capital Management LLC’s Largest Position
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Jan 5th, 2019 // No Comments
Bridge Creek Capital Management LLC lifted its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 56.6% during the 3rd quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The firm owned 40,729 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 14,721 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises 3.7% of Bridge Creek Capital Management LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its biggest holding. Bridge Creek Capital Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $7,337,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors also recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. RBO & Co. LLC boosted its holdings in Apple by 11.5% during the first quarter. RBO & Co. LLC now owns 69,380 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $11,641,000 after buying an additional 7,151 shares in the last quarter. Clearwater Capital Advisors LLC boosted its holdings in Apple by 1.4% during the first quarter. Clearwater Capital Advisors LLC now owns 23,864 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,004,000 after buying an additional 332 shares in the last quarter. FCG Advisors LLC boosted its holdings in Apple by 24.1% during the first quarter. FCG Advisors LLC now owns 27,444 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,605,000 after buying an additional 5,329 shares in the last quarter. First Pacific Advisors LLC boosted its holdings in Apple by 24.1% during the first quarter. First Pacific Advisors LLC now owns 17,000 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,852,000 after buying an additional 3,300 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Asset Management One Co. Ltd. lifted its position in shares of Apple by 1.2% in the 1st quarter. Asset Management One Co. Ltd. now owns 8,511,252 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,428,018,000 after acquiring an additional 99,807 shares in the last quarter. 57.08% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. Several equities research analysts recently commented on AAPL shares. UBS Group started coverage on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, September 12th. Maxim Group upped their price target on shares of Apple to $221.00 and gave the company an “average” rating in a research report on Thursday, September 13th. Royal Bank of Canada upped their price target on shares of Apple to $250.00 and gave the company an “average” rating in a research report on Wednesday, September 26th. Macquarie restated a “buy” rating and issued a $214.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, September 12th. Finally, BidaskClub downgraded shares of Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating in a research report on Wednesday, September 12th. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-six have issued a hold rating and twenty-one have assigned a buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock currently has an average rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $195.64.
Apple stock opened at $148.26 on Friday. The firm has a market cap of $775.31 billion, a PE ratio of 12.45, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.21 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a current ratio of 1.12, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. Apple Inc. has a 1-year low of $142.00 and a 1-year high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.78 by $0.13. The business had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $61.55 billion. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter last year, the firm earned $2.07 EPS. On average, research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 13.18 EPS for the current year.
In other news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 8,940 shares in the company, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders.

Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
